phrases.en: Where is the check-in counter for Korean Air?
phrases.tip: Where is the ~ for ~? — 원하는 장소 찾기 기본 패턴

phrases.en: I'd like to check in for the flight to New York.
phrases.tip: I'd like to ~ — 정중한 요청의 만능 패턴

phrases.en: Can I have a window seat, please?
phrases.tip: Can I have ~? — 부탁할 때. 창가 window seat / 통로 aisle seat

phrases.en: Here's my passport.
phrases.tip: 입국심사에서 여권 내밀며

phrases.en: I'm here for sightseeing.
phrases.tip: 입국심사 단골 질문 "Why are you visiting?"의 답

phrases.en: I'll be staying for about a week.
phrases.tip: "How long will you stay?"의 답

phrases.en: Where can I pick up my luggage?
phrases.tip: luggage = 짐 (baggage와 같은 뜻)

phrases.en: My luggage didn't come out.
phrases.tip: 짐 분실 시 이 말부터 — 직원에게 바로

phrases.en: I have a reservation under the name Kim.
phrases.tip: under the name ~ = ~ 이름으로 예약

phrases.en: What time is check-in?
Is breakfast included?
phrases.tip: Is ~ included? — 포함 여부 물어볼 때

phrases.en: Could I get an extra towel, please?
phrases.ko: 수건 하나 더 받을 수 있을까요?
phrases.tip: Could I get ~? — 호텔에서 가장 자주 쓰는 요청 (extra = 추가)

phrases.en: The air conditioner isn't working.
phrases.tip: The ~ isn't working — 물건 고장 신고 패턴

phrases.en: Can I check out a little later?
phrases.ko: 체크아웃을 조금 늦게 할 수 있을까요?

phrases.en: Could you call a taxi for me?
phrases.tip: Could you ~ for me? — 부탁의 정중한 패턴

phrases.en: A table for two, please.
phrases.tip: A table for N — 인원수 말할 때

phrases.en: Could I see the menu, please?
What do you recommend?
I'd like to order this one.
phrases.tip: 메뉴판 가리키며 this one

phrases.en: Could we have some more water?
Could I get the check, please?
phrases.tip: check = 계산서 (영국식은 bill)

phrases.en: Can I pay by card?
phrases.tip: by card = 카드로 / by cash = 현금으로

phrases.en: I'd like a latte to go, please.
phrases.tip: to go = 포장 / for here = 매장에서 먹기

phrases.en: Can I have it with oat milk?
Is this seat taken?
phrases.tip: taken = 사용 중 (빈자리 물어볼 때)

phrases.en: Could I have the Wi-Fi password?
Can I get a refill?
For here or to go?
phrases.tip: 상대 질문 — 알아듣기용. 매장 = for here

phrases.en: How much is this?
Do you have this in a different size?
phrases.tip: in a different size / color — 사이즈·색상 바꿀 때

phrases.en: Can I try this on?
phrases.tip: try on = 입어 보다 (신발에도 그대로 사용)

phrases.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
phrases.tip: 점원의 "Can I help you?"에 대한 정중한 거절

phrases.en: Can I get a tax refund?
phrases.tip: tax refund = 세금 환급 (면세 쇼핑)

phrases.en: I'd like to return this.
phrases.tip: return = 반품

phrases.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?
phrases.tip: How do I get to ~? — 길 묻기 만능 패턴

phrases.en: Is it far from here?

phrases.tip: on the map = 지도 위에 직접 표시

phrases.en: Which way is the beach?
Can I walk there?
I'm lost. Can you help me?
phrases.tip: I'm lost = 길을 잃었다 — 혼자 끙끙대지 말고 바로

phrases.en: How much is a ticket to downtown?
phrases.tip: a ticket to ~ = ~행 표

phrases.en: Does this bus go to the museum?
phrases.tip: Does this bus go to ~? — 버스 탈 때 필수 확인

phrases.en: Which stop should I get off at?
phrases.tip: get off = (교통수단에서) 내리다

phrases.en: Could you drop me off here?
phrases.tip: drop off = (차에서) 내려주다

phrases.en: How long does it take?
phrases.tip: How long does it take? — 소요 시간 물을 때

phrases.en: Can I pay with a card on the bus?
Can you help me, please?
I need a doctor.
phrases.tip: I need ~ — 급할 때 가장 확실한 표현

phrases.en: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
phrases.tip: the nearest ~ = 가장 가까운 ~

phrases.en: I lost my wallet.
phrases.tip: I lost my ~ — 분실 신고 패턴 (passport로 바꿔 쓰기)

phrases.en: Please call the police.
Where are you from?
phrases.tip: 상대 질문 — "I'm from Korea."로 답하기

phrases.en: I'm from Korea.

phrases.tip: first time = 처음 (first time in ~로 바꿔 쓰기)

phrases.tip: take a picture = 사진 찍다

phrases.en: It's beautiful here.
phrases.tip: 감탄 표현 — It's ~ here

phrases.en: What do you recommend seeing around here?
Have a nice day!
phrases.tip: 헤어질 때 만능 인사
